purpose: Derive and independently test the exact second-order coefficient of the scalar-Maxwell bulk action for C-PHYS-M1 on a fixed arbitrary six-dimensional background metric, with compact-support perturbations in the smooth bulk interior. This is a Hessian control subsector only and excludes gravitational, GHY, cap, junction, matter-observable and on-shell claims.

scope_contract.metric: fixed arbitrary background gbar_AB; h_AB=0 in WP1A
scope_contract.region: one smooth bulk interior region M_s^o
scope_contract.test_perturbations: varphi and a_A compactly supported in the interior, or equivalently chosen so boundary terms vanish for this control derivation
scope_contract.physical_background_requirement: not required for the off-shell Hessian coefficient; required before physical perturbation interpretation
scope_contract.diffeomorphism_gauge: not addressed because metric perturbations are disabled in this control subsector
scope_contract.U1_gauge: retained; the quadratic action depends on a_A only through f_AB=2*nabla_bar_[A a_B]

parent_bulk_subaction.formula: S_phiF=int d6X sqrt(-gbar)[-1/2 gbar^AB partial_A phi partial_B phi-U(phi)-1/4 Z_F(phi) F_AB F^AB]

generic_expansion_identities.scalar_gradient_square: (d phi)^2=(d phibar)^2+2 epsilon d phibar.d varphi+epsilon^2(d varphi)^2
generic_expansion_identities.field_strength_square: F^2=Fbar^2+2 epsilon Fbar^AB f_AB+epsilon^2 f_AB f^AB

generic_quadratic_lagrangian.formula: L_quad^(2)=-1/2 (nabla_bar varphi)^2-1/2 Ubar_phiphi varphi^2-1/4 Zbar f_AB f^AB-1/2 Zbar_phi varphi Fbar^AB f_AB-1/8 Zbar_phiphi Fbar^2 varphi^2

m1_specialization.quadratic_lagrangian: L_quad^(2)=-1/2(nabla_bar varphi)^2-1/2 M_varphi_varphi varphi^2-1/4 Zbar f_AB f^AB+C_varphi_f varphi Fbar^AB f_AB
m1_specialization.positivity_warning: M_varphi_varphi is a local Hessian coefficient, not a proven physical positive mass squared. In Lorentzian signature the sign of Fbar^2 is background-dependent, and no physical background is released.

hessian_euler_lagrange_operator.interpretation: Euler-Lagrange equations of the WP1A Hessian control functional; physical linearized perturbation equations only after an on-shell background and the omitted sectors are restored.

u1_gauge_check.does_not_address: diffeomorphism gauge, metric-scalar gauge mixing, cap bending gauge or global gauge-patch boundary data

what_is_proven_here: exact fixed-metric scalar-Maxwell second-order bulk coefficient for arbitrary background fields
exact C-PHYS-M1 specialization of the scalar-flux Hessian and mixing coefficients
agreement of the Hessian Euler-Lagrange operator with direct fixed-metric linearization of the parent scalar and Maxwell equations
local U(1) gauge invariance of the control subsector
what_remains_open: GHY second variation and gravitational boundary terms
cap Hessian, cap bending/fixed-interface gauge and perturbed junction conditions
S/V/T decomposition and diffeomorphism gauge control
mu eta Sigma growth and lensing
ghost freedom, kinetic positivity, gradient stability and mode spectrum
forbidden_inferences: Do not identify the WP1A scalar Hessian coefficient with an observed or on-shell particle mass.
Do not infer ghost freedom or stability from the fixed-metric scalar-Maxwell control action.
Do not infer a gravitational perturbation operator, Poisson equation, slip relation or lensing map.
Do not use the WP1A Maxwell U(1) gauge check as a substitute for diffeomorphism gauge control.
Do not set the background on shell or import a numerical background solution.
Do not release solver execution, K1-D or K1-E.
